description: Department of Labour - Notify the Minimum Rates of Wages for the Rubber, Plastic & Petroleum Resin Products; Printing Trade and Textile Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces proposed variations to wage decisions under the Wages Boards Ordinance, which constitutes regulatory and legal framework matters. It involves statutory instruments (Section 28 and 30 of the Ordinance) and compliance requirements for specific trades, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
